conditions.text: Required precondition: profile.consistent is true in every event (source module1.profile).
Required precondition: the backend must answer the second PUT /api/topics with a 500 while the first one returns 200, so you will likely need to force that server response to reproduce it.
App version is not a required condition: 2 events on 3.1.0 and 2 on 3.2.0.
Platform is not a required condition either: 2 events on iOS and 2 on Android, with OS versions 15 (2 events), 18.4 (1) and 17.6 (1).
Device model varies: Pixel 8 in 2 events, iPhone15,2 in 1, and UNKNOWN in 1.
The topics_v2 flag is not required to be on: 3 events had it on, 1 off.

Push state varies and so is not part of the repro: push.deliverable was false in 3 events and true in 1, OS permission was ALLOWED in 2 and DENIED in 2, and provider registration was REGISTERED in 3 and NOT_REGISTERED in 1.
No suspect commit was identified for this incident, so there is no code change to point at as a lead.

missing_evidence_questions.text: Why did the server return 500 on the second PUT /api/topics when the first identical call returned 200 - are there server-side logs or a response body for that request?
Does toggleTopic at notifications.ts:64 throw on any non-2xx response, or specifically on 500, and is the error surfaced or retried?
Is the failure tied to the second toggle in a session (switch#topic-news specifically), or would any second topic toggle reproduce it?
Which device produced the event with device.model UNKNOWN, and does that gap hide a device-specific pattern?
Given that no suspect commit was found, when did these 4 events start appearing and is there a release or backend deploy that lines up with them?

steps_prose.text: Bring the app to the foreground (all 4 events start with a foreground lifecycle transition).
Tap the switch#topic-jobs toggle; the resulting PUT /api/topics returns 200, so this first toggle succeeds.
Tap the switch#topic-news toggle; the resulting PUT /api/topics returns 500.
At that point toggleTopic raises Error: Topic toggle failed at src/modules/settings/notifications.ts line 64.

summary.text: The incident is an "Error: Topic toggle failed" thrown in toggleTopic at src/modules/settings/notifications.ts:64, seen across 4 events, and it happens when a second topic switch is toggled on the notification settings screen and the backend PUT /api/topics returns 500.
